role: Bounded publication review of local documentation and evidence; read-only except this report and ignored review artifacts.

scope.selection: All 72 original Phase 0 prerequisite additions between 23de38a and f676c1f, plus every tracked or non-ignored untracked file under docs/phase-1 present at the final scan. Includes finalized ACCEPTANCE.md, local-acceptance.json, complete committed-final gate evidence, full raw logs, all historical diagnostic outputs, public response copies and preserved failed attempts.
excluded: Ignored artifacts/, test-results/ and dist/; browser recordings/traces remain outside the intended publication set.
This review report is excluded from its own hash inventory.

assessment.note: Pattern absence alone is not proof of all possible secret absence. Broad hits were classified using the original generated fixtures, existing test source, metadata shapes, immutable capture helper and text log structure.

operations: Enumerate the exact Git-based candidate paths and original prerequisite diff.
Read every candidate byte; hash SHA-256, verify regular UTF-8 text/no NUL, inspect filename/extension, and parse every JSON file.
Scan key/token/header/query/URL patterns and observation/media payload markers without printing match values.
Classify broad positives by repository fixture/capture provenance; outputs contain filenames and categories only.
Compare all 73 protected-file hashes and verify no Phase 0, package/package-lock or public working-tree differences against the original checkpoint.
Verify artifacts, test-results and dist remain ignored. Recheck file hashes after scan.

limitations: This PASS is bound to the exact final file list and hashes below. Any later changed or added publication material requires its own scan; a later evidence-only commit must preserve these bytes.
This is a publication-material hygiene review, not a new numerical correctness, browser, security-vulnerability, credential-validity or deployment audit.
No credentials were tested, no private observations were fetched, and no remote write, commit, deployment or source/historical edit was performed.

The preserved public HTML response contains embedded small PNG page assets; the report does not claim an absolute absence of image bytes. No screenshots, video/audio recordings, trace archives or private recording payloads were present in the scanned publish inventory.
